title: BTC transactions can have multiple inputs and outputs
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  BTC txs can have multiple inputs and outputs and the relayer chooses the `reciever` and `onramp` contract based on the BTC transaction after users make the BTC transactions. The issue is that it's not clear which input address would be chosen as a token receiver and which output address is going to be chosen as an onramp contract. Funds may go to a different receiver address or the relayer may use the wrong onramp contract. If the relayer handles only specific BTC txs users should be informed about relayer limitations.  #
